entry.title: Website monitoring for small business: what to check first
entry.summary: How small businesses can watch important website pages, SSL certificate expiry and incident/recovery email alerts, with limitations and a practical checklist.
entry.content: Start with your homepage, contact or enquiry page, and customer booking page. Website monitors flag HTTP response failures and, where configured, missing page text. Check alerts from a second source before assuming a widespread outage. Learn the fundamentals and explore SiteGuard, a ClientStream service, at the linked guide.

entry.title: Website down? A small business outage response checklist
entry.summary: Verify a website outage, identify likely causes, communicate carefully and confirm recovery without unnecessary configuration changes.
